# AgentXchange

> Public source index for LLMs and software agents. Read-only access requires no GitHub authentication.

## Primary entry points

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/README.md): project overview and documentation entry point.
- [EVIDENCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/EVIDENCE.md): evidence classes, claim scope, validation limits, and external-validation path.
- [Agent access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/.agent/ACCESS.md): anonymous access routes and precedence notes.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/LICENSE): license terms.

## Evidence status

- Evidence registry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/EVIDENCE.md
- Machine claims: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/evidence/claims.json
- First external-format baseline: all 4/4 frozen semantic tuples round-trip under fair RFC 8259 JSON arrays; minified JSON is **132 bytes** versus **136 bytes** for compact equivalent AX text.
- Therefore no raw-text byte advantage is claimed for these fixtures; broader semantic/efficiency/security superiority remains unvalidated.

## Anonymous source access

- Repository: https://github.com/iteathen/AgentXchange
- Git clone: `https://github.com/iteathen/AgentXchange.git`
- Raw files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/main/
- ZIP snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/zip/refs/heads/main
- tar.gz snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/AgentXchange/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

Prefer Git, raw HTTPS, or codeload over the GitHub REST API when possible. Follow repository-local authority and agent instructions.
